footer.tagline: ethos: an app for tracking habits

common.coming_soon: This screen is still under construction.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter your email and we will send you a 6-digit code. If you do not have an account yet, it is created when you confirm the code.
login.code_sent: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It is valid for 10 minutes. If it does not arrive, check your spam folder.
login.resend_in: Send a new code in {{seconds}} s
login.consent: By continuing, you agree to the <terms>terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy> (links open in a new tab).

not_found.title: Page not found
not_found.text: This address does not exist or has changed.

timezone_notice.label: Time zone notice
timezone_notice.text: This device is in the {{browser}} time zone, but your account uses {{saved}}. Do you want to change your account's time zone?

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.dates_hint: Dates in your time zone ({{timezone}}), both days included.
accounts.confirm_label: To confirm, type the account email: {{email}}
accounts.block_warning: The person is signed out everywhere and cannot get a code or sign in until unblocked. The data stays.
accounts.email_warning: First, confirm the new email with a reply sent from it. The person is signed out everywhere, and both the old and the new email get a notice.
accounts.delete_warning: Deletes the account, its sessions and the habits it owns, with all their marks (guests' marks included). This cannot be undone.

user_habits.title: Habit content
user_habits.audit_notice: Every access to this content is recorded in the audit log, with your account and the time. Open it only when needed, such as for a support request or a case of abuse.
user_habits.author: Marked by

banners.title: Banners
banners.timezone_hint: Dates and times in your time zone ({{timezone}}). The banner shows from the start to the end; only one shows at a time: the one that started last.

errors.ends_before_starts: The end must be after the start.

day_panel.title: Day
day_panel.choose: Choose a day in the calendar to see its marks.

mark.author: By
mark.date_fixed: The date of a mark cannot be changed. To move it, delete it and add another one.
mark.invalid_note: The note is too long or has characters that are not allowed.
mark.invalid_cost: Enter a valid amount, such as 12.50.

role.editor: Shared with you: you can mark

habit.read_only_archived: This habit is archived and read-only. Unarchive it to mark again.
habit.read_only_viewer: You can view this habit, but not mark it.

home.empty: You do not have any habits yet.

terms_modal.title: New terms of use
terms_modal.text: We updated the terms of use and the privacy policy. To keep using ethos, read and accept the new version.
terms_modal.outdated: A newer version of the terms was published while this page was open. Reload the page to read it.

report.intro: Choose the period, the habits and what to show. The report and the files are generated in your browser.
report.period_hint: Days in your time zone ({{timezone}}), both included. At most 5 years.

period_errors.order: The end must be on or after the start.
period_errors.too_long: The period can cover at most 5 years.

fields.label: Information to show
fields.hint: Each item only shows for habits that have the feature turned on. The image never includes notes or emails.
fields.author: Who marked (CSV and JSON)

report.periods: Closed periods with the goal met

export.title: Export
export.hint: The image ({{width}}×{{height}}) is made for social networks and is shared or, where sharing files is not available, downloaded. CSV has one row per mark; JSON has everything in the report.
export.image_ready: Image ready. Check the preview below.
export.image_error: Could not create the image in this browser.

export_all.title: Export everything
export_all.text: All your habits, archived ones included, over the whole period and with every piece of information (notes and authors too). Good for keeping a copy of your data.

errors.bad_request: The request could not be understood. Reload the page and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.not_found: Not found. It may have been deleted or you lost access.
errors.conflict: This conflicts with another change. Reload the page and try again.
errors.validation_error: Some field is invalid. Check it and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.service_unavailable: The service is unavailable right now. Please try again later.
errors.database_unavailable: The service is unavailable right now. Please try again later.
errors.invalid_code: Invalid or expired code. Check the code or request a new one.
errors.invalid_timezone: Unknown time zone. Choose another one.
errors.terms_not_accepted: Accept the new version of the terms of use to continue.
errors.habit_limit_reached: You have reached the limit of active and paused habits. Archive or delete a habit to create another.
errors.habit_archived: This habit is archived and read-only. Unarchive it to make changes.
errors.mark_mode_mismatch: This habit's settings have changed. Reload the page.
errors.mark_limit_reached: This day has reached the mark limit for this habit.
errors.invite_limit_reached: You have reached the daily invite limit. Try again tomorrow.
errors.guest_limit_reached: This habit has reached its guest limit.
errors.shared_habit_limit_reached: You have reached the limit of habits shared with you. Leave one to accept this invite.
errors.last_admin: This is the last active administrator account and cannot be deleted. Create another administrator first.
errors.email_in_use: This email already belongs to an account. Choose another one.
errors.cannot_block_self: You cannot block your own account.
errors.network_error: No connection to the server. Check your internet and try again.

new_habit.title: New habit
new_habit.intro: Give it a name, pick a colour and a goal. The extra features start off and can be turned on now or later, in the habit settings.

habit_settings.title: Settings
habit_settings.archived_notice: This habit is archived: its settings are read-only. Unarchive it to edit them.

status.title: Pause and archive
status.pause_hint: Paused periods do not count in the score and trigger no alerts. You can still mark it.
status.resume_hint: It counts in the score and the alerts again from now on.
status.archive_hint: It leaves the main tab, becomes read-only and its score freezes. It does not count in the habit limit. You can unarchive it later.
status.unarchive_hint: It comes back to the main tab and counts in the limit of active and paused habits again.

delete.title: Delete the habit
delete.hint: Deletes the habit for everyone who takes part in it. This cannot be undone.
delete.warning: Deletes the habit with all its marks, including the guests' marks, plus its invitations, alerts and history. The guests get an email about it. This cannot be undone.

habit_form.name: Name
habit_form.code_hint: Up to 4 letters or digits. When set, it shows instead of the name.

features.multi_mark_hint: Off, each day is marked or not (one click). On, every mark counts.
features.duration_enabled_hint: Each mark has minutes, and the goal compares the sum of the period's minutes.
features.notes_enabled_hint: Each mark can have a free text, as a reminder.
features.score_enabled_hint: Shows the score from 0 to 100 and success or failure. Unlocks reward and punishment.
features.cost_enabled_hint: An amount of money per mark, added up in the report, with an optional limit.

kept.multi_mark: Days with several marks now count as one marked day. The extra marks are kept and count again if you turn this back on.
kept.duration_enabled: The minutes of the habit and of the marks are kept and come back when you turn this back on.
kept.notes_enabled: The notes of the marks are kept and come back when you turn this back on.
kept.score_enabled: The threshold, the reward and the punishment are kept and come back when you turn this back on.
kept.cost_enabled: The amounts of the habit and of the marks are kept and come back when you turn this back on.

habit_form.duration_minutes_hint: From 1 to {{max}} minutes. It is the duration of each mark, which can be changed in its details.
habit_form.score_threshold_hint: From 1 to 100 (default 70). A score equal or higher is a success.
habit_form.reward_hint: A reminder for when it is a success.
habit_form.punishment_hint: A reminder for when it is a failure.

cost_levels.habit: Per habit: a fixed amount on each mark
cost_levels.mark: Per mark: each mark has its own amount

habit_form.money_hint: No currency symbol, up to 2 decimals, like {{example}}.

errors.invalid_chars: Remove the invisible or control characters.
errors.invalid_code: Use 1 to 4 unaccented letters or digits.
errors.goal_range: Use a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
errors.threshold_range: Use a whole number from 1 to 100.

invalid.name: Invalid name: use 1 to 60 characters, on a single line.
invalid.code: Invalid code: use 1 to 4 unaccented letters or digits.
invalid.description: Invalid description: use at most 500 characters.
invalid.color: Pick one of the palette colours.
invalid.goal_count: This number does not work for this goal. At least 1, except with "at most", and no more than fits in the period.
invalid.duration_minutes: Enter the duration in whole minutes, from 1 to 1440.
invalid.score_threshold: Use a whole number from 1 to 100.
invalid.reward: Invalid reward: use at most 140 characters, with the score on.
invalid.punishment: Invalid punishment: use at most 140 characters, with the score on.
invalid.cost_level: Pick how the cost is set.
invalid.cost_cents: Enter a valid amount. It is required for a per-habit cost.
invalid.cost_limit_cents: Enter a valid amount for the limit.

goal_preview.label: Goal:
goal_preview.invalid: pick a valid number to see the goal.
goal_preview.minutes_min: With the duration on, the minutes add up: at least {{total}} min a {{period}}.
goal_preview.minutes_max: With the duration on, the minutes add up: at most {{total}} min a {{period}}.
goal_preview.minutes_exact: With the duration on, the minutes add up: exactly {{total}} min a {{period}}.
